subject.title: feat: make Commerce Products the public store catalog

question: Should Commerce expose a supported public Products-admin entry for this starter, or should the catalog integration be narrowed until one exists?
rationale: The current repository contract disallows the private admin-source alias, while publishing a stable replacement is an upstream Commerce API decision.

options.title: Require a public Commerce export
options.body: Have Commerce provide a supported Products-admin entry, update the pin, and remove the internal alias before merge.

options.title: Defer the native admin integration
options.body: Keep the starter on its existing supported surface until Commerce publishes an appropriate public entry point.

recommendation.title: Require a public Commerce export
recommendation.body: Have Commerce provide a supported Products-admin entry, update the pin, and remove the internal alias before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed Commerce catalog integration and can route the needed Commerce API decision.
